wholePhysicalScope: The six-point outer perimeter of OpenStreetMap way 143641503 is named and matches Wikidata Q1155331 and statutory Historic England reference 1357090. The adjacent Royal Opera Arcade is individually protected and separately mapped.
lodDetails: Four levels retain the mansard, domed pavilion and public facades. Near levels model the loggia, glass-and-iron canopy and dormers.
limitations: The model follows the surveyed footprint and the listed façade arrangement. Floor and roof heights, rear roof massing, column capitals and carved stone ornament are estimated.
The exterior omits commercial show graphics, the civic crest, interiors and the separately mapped adjacent Royal Opera Arcade.
